visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair and a white T-shirt is positioned in a brightly lit indoor room. He smiles at the camera while holding a black square compact. He uses his thumb to pry open the lid, revealing a vibrant red circular blush pan. (2) The scene shifts as the man presents several black retail boxes and open compacts showcasing red, pink, and beige shades. He holds them near his face, gesturing excitedly. The background remains stable with dark door frames and white walls. (3) He displays the back of his left hand which has three distinct streaks of blush colors applied. He points to each swatch while talking. Various text overlays in white and pink appear at the bottom and top of the frame. (4) The man takes a small makeup brush and looks into the mirror of the beige blush compact. He carefully dabs the brush into the pan and then applies it to his right cheek using circular motions. (5) He switches to a pink shade, layering it over the previous color. He then applies a deep red shade to his other cheek and a small amount on his upper eyelid. His facial expressions are expressive, often smiling or looking contemplative. (6) The video concludes with a split-screen effect showing both sides of his face to compare the different makeup results. He smiles widely and waves the compacts toward the lens.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian man with voluminous black hair, wearing a plain white crew-neck T-shirt and a small silver earring in his right ear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A energetic male voice begins speaking in Mandarin with a bright, high-arousal tone. An upbeat, rhythmic electronic pop BGM starts immediately, featuring a driving synthesized bass and crisp percussion. A sharp mechanical click sound punctuates the start as a plastic compact is opened. (2) The speaker continues his narration with frequent pitch rises to indicate enthusiasm. The BGM remains steady. A digital 'pop' sound effect is used to emphasize the appearance of text on screen. (3) A fast 'whoosh' transition SFX signals a scene change. The speaker maintains a high speech rate while describing product swatches. (4) The vocal delivery becomes slightly more focused and instructional as he describes the application process. A subtle 'ding' SFX is heard. The BGM continues throughout, providing a consistent energetic floor without masking the clear vocal signal. (5) In the final phase, the speaker's tone becomes inviting and interactive. He asks a question with a rising intonation. The BGM maintains its tempo until the audio track cuts cleanly at the end of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Product Display -> Color Swatching -> Application Demo -> Comparison -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and review a new line of Chanel blushes. By combining high-energy narration, clear close-up visuals of the product, swatches on skin, and a step-by-step application tutorial, the creator demonstrates the product's quality and versatility to his audience, encouraging engagement through comparison questions.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically features Chanel branding, names the product lines, and performs a dedicated review and tutorial using exclusively these items.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-arousal audio and fast-paced visual editing typical of beauty-influencer content to maintain viewer retention.
